traits.name: Inured to Poison
traits.description: The enforcer gains an advantage on tests to resist the effects of poison. Additionally, before the enforcer takes vital damage, they reduce it by 2.

traits.name: Ruthless
traits.description: After the enforcer knocks an enemy Prone, they can make an additional Strike against that target on that turn (even if they've already used that Strike action).

actions.name: Burn Pewter
actions.description: The enforcer uses the Invested Arts of another world to gain Enhanced [Strength +2], Enhanced [Speed +2], and a deflect value of 2 until the start of their next turn. At the start of each of their turns, the enforcer can spend 1 Investiture to maintain this effect for an additional round.

actions.name: Intimidate
actions.description: The enforcer makes an opposed Intimidation test against the Discipline of a target they can influence. If the enforcer succeeds, the target loses 1 focus and is no longer Focused.

strikes.name: Dueling Cane
strikes.on-hit: The enforcer can spend 1 focus to knock the target Prone.
strikes.description: Attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) impact damage. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) impact damage, and the enforcer can spend 1 focus to knock the target Prone.

strikes.name: Obsidian Dagger
strikes.on-hit: If the enforcer had at least one advantage on the attack, it deals an extra 5 (2d4) keen damage. On a Complication, this weapon breaks.
strikes.description: Attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 2 (1d4) keen damage. Hit: 10 (1d4 + 8) keen damage, and if the enforcer had at least one advantage on the attack, it deals an extra 5 (2d4) keen damage. On a Complication, this weapon breaks.
